preferredMechanism: Existing default catalog, eventually naming a generated standard file: tarball. No protocol adapter, shim, private published package or new readPackage hook.

nativeManager.name: pnpm
sourceFindings: catalogs-resolver accepts workspace:* and file: entries. Relative filesystem entries are re-anchored from workspace_dir to consumer_dir.
Native CLI source cases cover nested file-catalog consumers, lock catalog snapshots, frozen installs and pack re-anchoring. These upstream test sources were inspected and retained, not executed here.
Native pack re-anchors a file catalog dependency in a published manifest; it does not embed the referenced tarball. Re-anchoring alone does not make an exported consumer portable.

bootstrapFindings.behavior: resolveCatalog returns a selected scalar unchanged; materializeManifest rejects workspace: but neither re-anchors nor copies file: values. The snapshot generator copies catalog/owner/toolchain inputs and registered patches, not file-catalog tarballs.
bootstrapFindings.actualConsumers: None of the four standalone recipe templates declares nextra or nextra-theme-docs. Nextra is private docs-only; preserve that boundary.
bootstrapFindings.requiredProof: Materialize and pack all four current recipes with a candidate catalog snapshot and prove no local Nextra reference or missing artifact leaks into their active manifests. If a future bootstrap consumer uses Nextra, a governed artifact-copy/re-anchoring change is required before use; this packet does not supply it.

workspaceAlternative: Native workspace: catalog support exists, but an active workspace manifest under retained inputs is prohibited and standalone materialization rejects workspace:. Do not add the inert packet as a workspace.
patchAlternative: The repository has exact patchedDependencies and an early package hook. This packet registers neither. A code-only patch cannot be assumed to remove a resolution-time dependency edge. Prefer the complete source-built artifact with its corrected manifest once portable catalog qualification passes.
requiredPortableProof: Use the exact selected native manager through the existing runner and Node selector in serialized parent-owned scratch consumers; no ambient shim or alternate manager.

Resolve the same generated tarball from a root consumer and apps/docs at different nesting depths on Windows and POSIX; verify package identity, content digest and the theme's exact nextra 4.6.1 peer.

Move or copy the entire candidate checkout/artifact layout, reinstall from a frozen lockfile in a clean consumer and prove there is no absolute host path or dependence on an earlier node_modules tree.
Inspect the resolved graph: no better-react-mathjax, mathjax-full or replacement MathJax/SRE prerelease enters through this variant; KaTeX paths and current family remain.
Only after complete generation and acceptance may the parent choose a durable artifact path and edit the catalog/lock. A .build scratch tarball is not a portable final binding.
